name: native-runtime-route-registry
objective: Close app-captain native/runtime configuration, route/screen registry, deep-link, update/build and permission parity so declared capabilities match reachable Captain behavior.
truthOwner: app-captain native capability and route declarations must match reachable Product Truth; device permissions may not exceed proven Captain behavior.

tasks.objective: Converge native capabilities and least-privilege permissions
tasks.currentProblem: The manifest declares background location and other sensitive native capabilities without complete proof that reachable Captain behavior requires and implements them.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace every app-captain feature flag into generated Android/iOS config and runtime consumers. Remove unneeded permissions/plugins when Product Truth does not require them, or implement the governed native lifecycle when it does. Preserve foreground location, camera, notifications and secure storage only with direct consumers and failure handling.
tasks.targetState: Native declarations, permissions and runtime behavior are one intentional Captain contract with no permission overreach.
tasks.action: Trace current callers and owners first; implement root-cause changes; delete proven obsolete Captain residue; then run linked checks and re-audit negative/error paths.
mustNotChange: Do not create a parallel truth.
Do not broaden into unrelated journeys.
Do not convert unavailable/ambiguous state into success.
Do not keep proven dead Captain compatibility paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Native declarations, permissions and runtime behavior are one intentional Captain contract with no permission overreach.
Every live native capability has a direct Captain consumer or is removed.
tasks.rollback: Revert only focused native/route changes; never restore permission overreach or a contradictory route.
tasks.commitBoundary: Focused U002 native/runtime/route-registry commit after BB reconciliation.

tasks.objective: Make route/screen/deep-link registry match the live Captain surface
tasks.currentProblem: Registry metadata and actual route renderers can diverge, producing unreachable, disabled or stale screens.
tasks.requiredChange: Enumerate every DshCaptainRoute, registry record, command target, deep-link/action target and renderer branch; ensure each live entry resolves to its declared owner/component and required states; remove proven dead aliases/types/copy and reject unsupported deep links safely.
tasks.targetState: Every registered Captain route is reachable and truthful or explicitly removed; every live route is registered and bounded.
tasks.action: Perform caller/reachability census, converge live routes, delete dead residue, then rerun mobile and registry checks.
mustNotChange: Do not invent routes outside Product Truth.
Do not leave disabled live routes registered as verified.
Do not accept unsafe notification/deep-link schemes.
Do not retain dead aliases without callers.
acceptanceCriteria: Registry, renderer, deep link and owner path agree for every Captain route.
tasks.rollback: Revert only focused registry convergence while preserving one truthful live route per capability.
tasks.commitBoundary: Focused route/registry cleanup after reachability proof.
